round_interpretation: All 149 historical masks have complete three-seed evidence on the repaired common 84-month initial history. The cumulative front has eight points and hypervolume 0.5152122634950599. Larger rate/credit/commodity masks improve IC and Sharpe but have worse NLL than the compact FX/market-risk anchor. A newly available risk-volatility mask bridges these extremes. Earlier small-context gold-ratio and DXY findings do not establish their value in the new broad front. The novelty gate identified that whole credit/inflation and whole rate/TIPS block removals had already been tested: the former is dominated by the broad parent, while the latter trades lower IC/Sharpe for better NLL. Those repeats were replaced with targeted HY-change and reduced TIPS-representation hypotheses before registration. This round uses eight explicit pruning tests, one frontier bridge, and three genuine representation/information explorations; no weighted score, extra holdout, kernel tuning, or requirement to eliminate lag is introduced.

candidates.name: high_sharpe_without_gold_oil_ratio
candidates.hypothesis: The ratio may remain redundant or noisy even in the broad high-Sharpe rate/credit/commodity context; retain oil return and copper return while removing only the ratio.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Seek an equally competitive smaller configuration or a new Pareto tradeoff; do not assume the small-context result generalizes.
candidates.falsification: Consistent degradation across the three objectives or exclusion from the cumulative front without a useful simplification would reject this pruning hypothesis.

candidates.name: high_sharpe_without_dxy_level
candidates.hypothesis: EM-FX return and the broad macro state may carry the useful currency information without a DXY level input in this richer configuration.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Test whether a smaller currency representation retains useful IC/Sharpe and improves NLL, while preserving genuine three-objective tradeoffs.
candidates.falsification: A material new deterioration or a dominated result would show that the earlier small-context DXY finding does not transfer here.

candidates.name: high_sharpe_without_hy_spread_change
candidates.hypothesis: The full credit/inflation block cannot be removed without losing the broad parent's advantage, but HY change may be redundant with HY z-score and the HYG/LQD change proxy within that useful block.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Preserve useful repaired credit information while testing whether one noisy derivative can be removed competitively.
candidates.falsification: A dominated removal without a useful objective tradeoff would establish conditional value for HY change in this broad equity context.

candidates.name: high_sharpe_with_reduced_tips_representation
candidates.hypothesis: The nominal yield, curve, and breakeven proxy may retain the useful rate state without both direct one-month SCHP return and its trailing three-month average; breakeven still contains TIPS-derived change information.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Seek a two-input reduction that preserves more of the broad parent's IC/Sharpe than the already tested full five-input rate-block removal.
candidates.falsification: If this smaller rate representation is dominated without a useful density benefit, the retained transforms are not sufficient in this context.

candidates.name: high_ic_without_six_month_momentum
candidates.hypothesis: The six-month momentum input may be redundant with skip-month annual momentum, cross-sectional rank, trend slope, and the rich macro state; directly test the local basis rather than assuming all four momentum inputs matter.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Seek a one-input simplification near the high-IC end of the front; retain a nondominated density/portfolio tradeoff if one emerges.
candidates.falsification: Clear loss of the high-IC advantage without useful NLL/Sharpe improvement rejects this removal.

candidates.name: risk_front_without_vix_slope_change
candidates.hypothesis: VIX slope level and its trailing z-score may already provide the useful term-structure state without the one-month change.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Reduce a potentially noisy derivative while measuring all three objective changes and predictive coverage.
candidates.falsification: A dominated result or consistent loss of useful ranking/density evidence would indicate the derivative adds information here.

candidates.name: risk_front_without_tlt_volatility_proxy
candidates.hypothesis: The TLT-realized-volatility proxy may be unnecessary when VIX and the SPY realized-minus-implied proxy coexist in this international-equity model.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Test a cleaner risk representation without assuming the TLT proxy has the same relevance for fixed-income families.
candidates.falsification: A noncompetitive objective deterioration would establish conditional value for the rate-volatility proxy in this equity context.

candidates.name: risk_front_without_absolute_trend_slope
candidates.hypothesis: Dimensionless momentum inputs may carry the useful trend information without the absolute-price slope, simplifying a candidate that already bridges IC and density objectives.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Measure ranking, density, portfolio behavior, and uncertainty quality rather than assuming a redundant-looking transform can safely be removed.
candidates.falsification: Consistent loss of the front position without a competitive simplification rejects this removal.

candidates.name: risk_front_plus_oil_return_only
candidates.hypothesis: Oil return may add the useful commodity state to the new risk-volatility bridge without bringing in copper or the noisy gold/oil ratio.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Seek additional frontier hypervolume, preserving cases where IC/NLL/Sharpe trade off rather than forcing the earlier oil result.
candidates.falsification: A dominated addition or deterioration with no useful objective improvement rejects this cross-front transfer.

candidates.name: risk_front_with_alternative_local_basis
candidates.hypothesis: The compact local basis already used as a fixed-income hypothesis may pair more effectively with the risk macro state than the inherited equity momentum/rank/slope basis; this directly explores a candidate shared representation.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Keep the local input count fixed while testing a genuinely different representation; this is a hypothesis, not evidence of universal relevance.
candidates.falsification: A dominated result would argue against transferring this local basis to international equities under the fixed model policy.

candidates.name: risk_front_plus_etf_realized_volatility
candidates.hypothesis: Task-specific trailing realized volatility may contribute density information absent from market-wide risk proxies, potentially improving NLL without sacrificing useful ranking and portfolio behavior.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Judge uncertainty by NLL and coverage/sharpness diagnostics; a narrower predictive distribution alone does not count as improvement.
candidates.falsification: A dominated addition or narrower but worse-calibrated forecasts would reject the proposed information benefit.

candidates.name: risk_front_plus_recent_excess_return_lag
candidates.hypothesis: Lagged realized excess return might have different conditional value in the new richer risk model than in the weak simple-local pair; test the claim rather than requiring lag removal.
candidates.expected_tradeoff: Evaluate the three objectives and seed consistency, preserving a genuine tradeoff if lag helps density but hurts ranking.
candidates.falsification: A dominated addition, or an objective tradeoff not competitive with the cumulative front, would not support keeping lag in this context.
